correctness.rationale: The disk Bergman monomials remain orthogonal under τ|f^(m)(0)|² and the m-th norm changes from 1/(m+1) to (1+d)/(m+1), where d=τ(m+1)(m!)². Consequently K=(1−t)^−2−c t^m, c=(m+1)d/(1+d), and zeros satisfy 1−c t^m(1−t)²=0. On |t|=1, t^m(1−t)²=4sin²(θ/2)e^{i((m+1)θ+π)}, so boundary crossings occur at odd angles θ=(2j+1)π/(m+1) with explicit reciprocal amplitude. For physical c<m+1 the only potential nonzero multiple root t=m/(m+2) cannot satisfy c t^m(1−t)²=1, because c max_{t∈[0,1]}g_m(t)<4(m+1)/(m+2)²<1. Implicit derivative dlog|t|/dc=−Re[1/(m−2t/(1−t))]/c<0 at every boundary crossing, making inward crossings exhaustive from small-c zero-free base. This proves the exact strict threshold count, the first-crossing parity law, and the last-crossing criterion 4n sin²(π/(2n))>1, true exactly n=2..9 (m≤8). For fixed τ>0, c=n−o(1) and counting odd angles near zero yields N=n−sqrt(n)/π+O(1). Independent numerical polynomial roots at m=1..12 and multiple couplings matched analytic count; inspected Git blob b88445397e5d1be89db1036b49ef61feb6b208e4. Caution: number of scalar zero fibres t is not count of (z,w) pairs.

value.rationale: Rank-one derivative penalization is a natural Sobolev-type renorming of the disk Bergman Hilbert space. The exact Lu-Qi-Keng zero staircase, parity-dependent onset, sharp ninth-jet obstruction to maximal fibres, and large-order asymptotic are concrete all-parameter kernel-zero invariants, not mere verification of an existing Gram-kernel formula. The result distinguishes two physically different operations: changing the reproducing norm versus taking a Gram kernel of jet functionals.
